#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> l(n);
    
    int x = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0) x++;
        else x--;
        l[i] = x;
    }
    
    vector<int> costs;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if (l[i] == 0) {
            costs.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i+1]));
        }
    }
    
    sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());
    
    int cuts = 0;
    int sum = 0;
    for (int cost : costs) {
        if (sum + cost <= b) {
            sum += cost;
            cuts++;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    
    cout << cuts;
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
